chapter: Hollywood and the break with Thornhill
title: Her view of the Hollywood experience while opening a club
summary: She wasn't happy making the picture but was a success at the club she opened in Hollywood; she was out there in 1939.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Unfortunately, I missed it. But it wasn't one of the happiest experiences in your life evidently.
No. I was going out there to Hollywood to make a picture and you don't know what to expect.
I was working in a club at the same time. I was having tremendous success. I was out on the Strip. I was working at the Versailles, which later became Mocambo, or something like that.
But I opened that club out there. So while I was on to making the picture, I was appearing at night too.
I didn't let it bother me too much. As I said --
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Do you remember when exactly you were out in Hollywood?

That was in 19 -- it was really 1939. And I guess I was out there -- it probably took about four weeks to do my part. And then, of course, I went back again and did another picture the same year, which we'll talk about later.
